This comparison, titled Karakteristika for patienter med PSC (indikator 7), examines the characteristics of patients with [[dk830f-primaer-skleroserende-kolangitis|DK830F Primær skleroserende kolangitis]] (PSC) as tracked by [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]], specifically contrasting newly diagnosed (nydiagnostiseret) and prevalent (prævalent) patient groups [^src1]. Because the data is drawn from a single reporting period in the 2024 registry, no longitudinal trends can be established across multiple years [^src1]. 

In terms of demographics, both groups show a strong male predominance, which is typical for the condition. Among newly diagnosed patients, men lead as the majority, accounting for 68% (21 patients) compared to 32% (10 patients) for women [^src1]. The prevalent cohort mirrors this exact distribution, with 227 men (68%) and 105 women (32%) out of a total of 332 prevalent patients [^src1]. The age profiles are also remarkably consistent between the two groups: the average age is 45 years (range 16-87) for newly diagnosed patients and 46 years (range 16-90) for prevalent patients [^src1]. The median age for both groups is exactly 44 years [^src1].

Regarding healthcare utilization, prevalent patients have a slightly higher median number of contacts (6, IQR 3-12) compared to newly diagnosed patients (4, IQR 3-13) [^src1]. However, the average number of contacts is slightly higher for the newly diagnosed group (9 vs. 8) [^src1]. An outlier in the contact data is the exceptionally wide range of contacts (1 to 23) for both groups, indicating highly variable and individualized care needs [^src1]. The dominant mode of contact for both groups is physical (in-person) consultations, leading virtual interactions by a wide margin: physical contacts account for 67% (78 contacts) for newly diagnosed patients and 62% (829 contacts) for prevalent patients [^src1]. Virtual contacts make up the remaining 33% (38 contacts) and 38% (517 contacts), respectively [^src1]. No specific clinical targets, thresholds, or standards are defined in this dataset to evaluate met or missed goals [^src1].
